title: Session 2026-10-28, catalogue and checkout repair
verdict: Stripe works and the catalogue works. Google has indexed almost none of it, so traffic is the constraint.

shipped.title: 2,024 pages submitted to IndexNow (Bing, Yandex, DuckDuckGo)
shipped.detail: Google had 299 submitted URLs at 0 indexed, so waiting on Google alone was the bottleneck. IndexNow is free and unauthenticated apart from a key file, and it feeds Bing, whose index backs Copilot and DuckDuckGo answers. The submitter verifies the key file body before sending, then reads the live sitemap instead of guessing URL shapes: 2,024 accepted / 0 failed on claudecodeguides.com, plus 299 / 0 on mcp.zovo.one. Total 2,323 URLs pinged today, every batch returning 200.

shipped.title: Fixed 10 live guide pages that published '{% raw %}' as their title
shipped.detail: Front matter sat inside a Liquid raw block, so Jekyll published the tags literally. Moved front matter above the block; proven in an isolated build that titles parse and JSON braces survive.

shipped.title: 2 new awesome-list PRs opened (mergeable)
shipped.detail: Distribution was stuck on lists that already listed us. Two lists where a code search returned zero mentions of Zovo now have real PRs: AlexMili/Awesome-MCP #339 and lobstercare/mcp-hub #113, each a single line in the repo's own format. Both verified OPEN + MERGEABLE, 1 file changed. Pitfall recorded: gh repo fork silently no-ops when you own a repo of the same name, so the fork parent must be verified before pushing.

shipped.title: Server pages now link their walk-through
shipped.detail: The 11 how-to guides were orphans: nothing in the catalogue linked to them. Ten server pages now carry a descriptive-anchor link to the guide that shows the job end to end (e.g. time-tracker -> 'MCP server for time tracking'), with selftest asserting the server id exists, the guide file exists and the page actually links it. Verified live on GitHub Pages.

shipped.title: 58 competing mirrors consolidated
shipped.detail: The same server existed at three URLs, each self-canonical: mcp.zovo.one/s/<id> (4,714 words), theluckystrike.github.io/mcp/<id> (525) and claudecodeguides.com/mcp/<id> (744). Duplicate clusters, zero consolidation. The github.io mirror now carries canonical_url -> the claudecodeguides copy (verified live), so signals land on the domain with 2,023 sitemap URLs instead of being split three ways. The page layout had canonical hardcoded, so it now honours page.canonical_url.

shipped.title: Every buy button pointed at a 404
shipped.detail: The generator emitted &src=... instead of ?src=..., so all 58 buy links resolved to https://mcp.zovo.one/buy/<id>&src=... which returns 404 — the only revenue click on the whole public surface was dead. Fixed to ?src=hub.<slug>, every CTA is now attributable, and selftest.py fails the build if any buy link is untagged or malformed. Verified live on GitHub Pages.

shipped.title: Hosted endpoint claim made truthful
shipped.detail: Every page used to promise a hosted URL even where the worker had no route. A 58-endpoint MCP handshake sweep found 46 live / 12 missing; pages, FAQ copy and JSON-LD offers are now driven by data/hosted_live.json, so the 12 local-only servers say so. Regression gate added to selftest.py.

shipped.title: claudecodeguides.com deploy unblocked
shipped.detail: The CI deploy had been failing for days with Cloudflare 'Authentication error 10000': the repo secret was stale. Rotated CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN / CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID to the working credentials, excluded vendor+bundle from the Jekyll build, pushed the hub + 10 guides — and the deploy went green: https://claudecodeguides.com/mcp/ answers 200, its sitemap.xml grew from 1,953 to 2,023 URLs, and IndexNow accepted all 71 /mcp/ URLs. (Correction: 1,953 was the sitemap size, not an indexation count — that domain is not in our GSC properties, so its indexation is unmeasured.)

shipped.title: Public MCP catalogue, 70 pages
shipped.detail: 58 server pages + 11 how-to guides + index, unique copy, SoftwareApplication + FAQPage JSON-LD, sitemap-mcp.xml in the sitemap index, nav + homepage card. Deploys on git push (GitHub Pages), so this is the one web surface that can change without a Cloudflare token.

shipped.title: Checkout proven end-to-end
shipped.detail: Real browser headers → 303 → checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_live_…. The rail was never broken; the earlier “404 on POST” reading was the bot guard answering a scripted probe.

shipped.title: mcp-servers README → catalogue
shipped.detail: PR #95 adds the catalogue link above the fold. Blocked from merging by the required “Billing preflight” check, which needs one approval.

shipped.title: Repo description cleaned
shipped.detail: Removed the stray “mcprush.com-…” verification string, replaced with an accurate description plus the catalogue URL.

shipped.title: AEO answer set (10 pages)
shipped.detail: Answer-shaped drafts for the queries buyers actually type: “generate invoice PDF from Claude”, “edit Excel in Claude”, “convert bank statement to CSV”. Ready to publish on the catalogue.

shipped.title: Launch kit
shipped.detail: Show HN, r/mcp, r/ClaudeAI, dev.to, X thread, 5-email welcome sequence.

next.title: npm login  (5 minutes, unblocks the most)
next.detail: 58 packages with real READMEs on the registry the MCP directory indexes. Then `npm publish --access public` in each servers/*/ dir. Tokens: 0 → 58 indexable pages, and every LLM that reads npm learns the names.

next.title: Merge PR #95, then 3 more contextual links
next.detail: One dofollow link from an indexed page is worth more than 58 new pages on a domain Google has not discovered. Targets that already exist and are already indexed: claudecodeguides.com (1,953 URLs), chrometipsguide.com, bestchromeextensions.com.

next.detail: They are written. They cost nothing to publish because the catalogue deploys on push.
